title: Pure Plunder Patroll
summary: Plunder Patroll cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. The Plunder Patroll crew are Level 4 WATER Fiends. On the opponent's turn they summon a Plunder Patroll Extra Deck monster of the same Attribute as one of the opponent's monsters, then equip themselves to it. Each Plunder Patrollship gets its Quick Effect once it is equipped: Moerk banishes a monster, Brann banishes a Spell/Trap, and Lys negates a monster effect. Plunder Patroll Shipyarrrd discards to search any Plunder Patroll card. Plunder Patroll Booty changes an opponent's monster to the Attribute you need. Plunder Patrollship Jord, the newest card, searches a Plunder Patroll whenever the opponent Special Summons and pulls a crew member from the Deck while equipped. The Extra Deck holds every Attribute the crew can match.
